name: Youth Advisory Commission
what_you_do: Plan events and give the City Council ideas on policy for the city's teens. The commission meets once a month.
who_can_apply: Walnut residents in grades 9 to 12 with at least a 3.0 GPA. You must be active in at least one activity, like a sports team or service club.
pay_detail: The city does not mention pay
deadline_text: The last notice set a deadline of June 11, 2026. Dates for next year are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Get the application from the City Clerk, 21201 La Puente Road, or call 909-348-0710. You turn in the full supplemental packet at one time, in person or by email to tdedios@walnutca.gov.
notes: Meetings are the second Monday of each month at 5 p.m. at the Walnut Gymnasium/Teen Center. They are open to the public.
